newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU farm chief Fischler launches Internet site.
newsitem.headline: EU farm chief Fischler launches Internet site.

text.p: European Union Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler on Thursday launched a World Wide Web site on the Internet.
It is the latest stage in a campaign started last November to bring the EU closer to its 370 million citizens through a wider distribution of information on the Internet via the EUROPA site.

Farmers and consumers will be able to see key documents, speeches, background information and a personal portrait, including photographs, of the Austrian Commissioner by typing "http://europa.eu.int/en/comm/dg06/com/htmfiles/welcome.htm".
They can also write to Fischler by electronic mail addressed to "kabinett-fischler@cab.cec.be".
